verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Logseq can export the entire graph in open formats: EDN, JSON, standard Markdown, OPML, HTML and Roam-compatible JSON. Users also credit its local data and markdown/git-based storage with keeping them in control and able to leave. Community notes that the stored Markdown/Org is non-standard and that the new DB version no longer keeps data as markdown files qualify the openness, but they do not contradict the export feature. Missing for 10: hands-on corroboration that full-graph export is complete and faithful (including assets and DB-version graphs), and assurance that the native storage stays in standard open formats.
